review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Some people think argue that advertising has good effect on economic. Many other hold a opinion, saying that this would cause negative social effect because it makes people unhappy with their life. In my opinion both of these views are correct.

On the one hand, advertising bring undeniable economic benefits. Creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand. When spending power is encouraged, production is encouraged, which create more employment opportunities and greater state revenue through taxation to contributing a stronger economy. For instance, e-commerce platforms like Shopee or Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers. This boosts not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. Additionally, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design, which makes it an important driver of economic activity.

On the other hand, advertising has negative social consequences. Advertisements constantly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards or luxury possessions, which foster dissatisfaction among viewers. As an example, young people in particular feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook. This lead to frustration when they cannot afford them. In addition, advertising promote materialistic values and money-driven culture in the long run.
Overall, I think I agree at both views, it is valid to some certain extent, and advertising contribute to social dissatisfaction, also it play a crucial role in economic development.

completion.comment: Bài có đủ bốn phần; đoạn kết cần rõ quan điểm và đúng cấu trúc câu.

review.overall: Em đã hoàn thành đủ bốn đoạn và triển khai được cả hai view. Chuỗi nhu cầu–sản xuất–việc làm ở Body 1 khá rõ, còn Body 2 đã đi tới dissatisfaction và materialistic values. Em cần sửa kỹ chủ ngữ và động từ, đồng thời viết Conclusion bằng hai câu rõ ràng thay vì nối nhiều ý bằng dấu phẩy.

paragraphs: Some people argue that advertising has positive economic effects, whereas others believe that it can create social dissatisfaction. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand. Greater spending encourages production, creates employment opportunities and increases state revenue through taxation, thereby contributing to a stronger economy. For instance, Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, which boosts both their sales and the wider digital retail sector. Furthermore, advertising creates direct jobs in marketing, media and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. Constant images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards and luxury possessions may make viewers dissatisfied with their own lives. Young people can then feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or smart gadgets promoted on TikTok and Facebook. This pressure leads to frustration when they cannot afford such products. Over time, repeated exposure to these messages may encourage materialistic values and strengthen a money-driven culture.
In conclusion, advertising can stimulate economic activity and employment. At the same time, it may cause social dissatisfaction and strengthen a money-driven culture.

nextSteps: Viết lại cặp câu chủ đề: supporters of advertising ở Body 1 và those on the other side/opponents of advertising ở Body 2.
Rà lại mọi động từ sau advertising, this và which.
Viết Conclusion thành hai câu ngắn, mỗi câu chốt một mặt của đề.

task.text:
Some people say advertising has positive economic effects. Others think it has negative social effects because it will make people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
